intro: Sri Lanka is famous for tea, clothing exports and tourism, and is recovering from its 2022 crisis.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Ceylon tea, clothing, rubber and spices like cinnamon are major exports. Tourism and money from Sri Lankans abroad are important.

chapters.title: Crisis and recovery
text: In 2022 Sri Lanka ran out of money for fuel and food imports and defaulted on its debts. With IMF help, the economy has begun to recover.

keyTerms.meaning: Failing to repay debts on time.
